title: Section 8 — Presidency Small Cause Courts — CPC 1908

content.heading: Presidency Small Cause Courts
content.text: Save as provided in sections 24, 38 to 41, 75, clauses (a), (b) and (c), 76, 77, 157 and 158, and by the Presidency Small Cause Courts Act, 1882, the provisions in the body of this Code shall not extend to any suit or proceeding in any Court of Small Causes established in the Presidency towns.
